title: Owner-to-Diner Staging Dish Cases
purpose: Prepare three dish scenarios for staging validation without claiming live execution.

allergen_terminology.note: Missing ingredients or allergen information must never be interpreted as proof of safety.

dish_cases.scenario: Complete dish with owner correction and explicit publication

expected_correction.new_value: Fictional rice bowl with rice, carrot, and cucumber

dish_cases.expected_owner_result: Correction persists after successful save; explicit approval is required before publication.
dish_cases.expected_diner_result: Only the approved complete dish and permitted image are displayed.

dish_cases.scenario: Incomplete dish with missing ingredients and image

original_fields.name: Mystery Pasta
original_fields.description: Fictional pasta dish with incomplete source information

expected_correction.note: Must be supplied and approved by the restaurant; do not infer ingredients.

dish_cases.expected_owner_result: Incomplete draft cannot be published as a complete dish.
dish_cases.expected_diner_result: Incomplete placeholder cannot open readable detail or comparison and emits no dish_viewed event.

dish_cases.scenario: Changed revision, publication replacement, and withdrawal

expected_correction.new_value: Fictional roasted potato and carrot plate

dish_cases.expected_owner_result: Unapproved changes do not replace the published revision; replacement requires explicit approval.
dish_cases.expected_diner_result: Fresh load displays the approved replacement; after withdrawal, fresh load no longer presents the dish as available.

review_requirements.adam: Review expected product behavior and updated allergen terminology.
review_requirements.shirley: Confirm owner dashboard and diner journey expectations.
review_requirements.jeffin: Coordinate staging execution after dependencies are ready.
